info.title: BOTG ContentHub API
info.description:
Contract (source of truth) for the BOTG ContentHub product API. Greenfield target design — describes how the API should look, independent of the Directus backend. Mapping from the native Directus structure to these fields lives in the implementation tickets and the `field_dictionary`, not in this document.

**Two families:** `products` (web, aggregated, no purchase prices) and per-product backoffice families such as `hotels` (full data incl. EK/margin).

**Three access patterns each:** list (slim directory), `/full` (all records; delta/DIV sync via `updated_after`), `/{id}` (single record).

One language per response (`lang` mandatory). `date_updated` is present in every response as the consumer's delta cursor.

**Field labels** (the caption of each field, per language) are served separately via `GET /metadata/labels` — fetched once and cached — so the data feed stays slim. Value labels (e.g. catering, classification) travel inline as `Ref.name`.

Open points flagged **TBD**: final backoffice status rule; full Markdown-blob scope; `updated_after` boundary & de-publish semantics.

get.summary: Field labels (field_key -> label) in the requested language
get.description:
Returns the field-label map so consumers can render captions in the requested language without inflating the data feed. Intended to be fetched **once and cached**.

- **Field labels** (this endpoint) = the caption of a field, e.g. `minimum_stay` -> "Mindestaufenthalt". Served **live from the Directus field metadata** (`meta.translations`), so they are always current; the brief label columns DE/EN/NL are only the build source.
- **Value labels** (e.g. catering "Halbpension", classification "4 Sterne") are NOT here — they travel inline in the data as `Ref.name`.
- **Dynamic labels** (repeater headlines, surcharge names) are content and travel with the record.

Returned product-wide by default; use `collection` to restrict.

Maps legacy Primarix fields to their new API names, to help existing consumers transition. Token-gated; honours the `audience` governance flag — only **public** and **backoffice** rows are exposed, **internal** never. Intended to be fetched **once and cached**.

- **Default (`flat`):** one row per legacy source — look up your `legacy_fieldid` and read `api_field_name`.
- **`new` fields** appear with null `legacy_*` and a set `api_field_name` (status=new) — 'this is new'.
- **`outdated` fields** (used in Primarix but not imported) appear with null `api_field_name` (status=outdated) — 'this is gone'.
- **`?shape=nested`** returns one row per new field with the legacy sources embedded.

Labels are returned in full (`label_de`/`label_en`/`label_nl`); this endpoint takes no `lang`.

bearerAuth.description: Web token -> partner. Row-level visibility (which products a partner may see) is enforced via the token; the fields partner_visibility / partner_selected belong to authorization and are NOT part of any response body.

LangParam.name: lang
LangParam.description: Response language (mandatory). One language per response, inlined. Values are the Directus locale codes.

UpdatedAfterParam.name: updated_after
UpdatedAfterParam.description: Delta cursor: returns only records changed after this timestamp. Available on /full only. TBD: inclusive/exclusive boundary, and whether de-publishing (a record leaving 'published') is surfaced as a change so consumers can detect removals.

IdParam.name: id
IdParam.description: Record id — accepts the UUID or the numeric object_id.

CollectionParam.name: collection
CollectionParam.description: Optional: restrict to one collection. Default: all collections.

MapCollectionParam.name: collection
MapCollectionParam.description: Optional: restrict to one target collection.

ShapeParam.name: shape
ShapeParam.description: Response shape. `flat` (default) = one row per legacy source (direct old->new lookup). `nested` = one row per new field with embedded legacy sources.

Ref.description: Resolved reference to a lookup record. `name` is already in the requested language.

GeoRef.description: Resolved geography reference (country / state / region / place), name in requested language.

date_updated.description: Required in every response; basis for the consumer's delta cursor.

allOf.description: Backoffice adds Tour32, source IDs and reservation data.

CollectionLabels.description: Map of field_key -> field label in the requested language.

data.description: Field labels grouped by collection (key = collection name).

PrimarixSource.description: One legacy Primarix origin of a target field.

FieldMapFlatRow.description: Flat lookup row: one row per legacy source. `new` fields have null legacy_* ; `outdated` fields (used in Primarix, not imported) have null api_field_name.

api_field_name.description: Name in the API/dump (post-transformer). null when status=outdated.

FieldMapNestedRow.description: Target-centric row: one per new field, legacy origins embedded. Returned with ?shape=nested.

data.description: Default: flat rows (one per legacy source). With `?shape=nested`: target-centric rows. All items in one response share the shape set by `shape`.
